description: Query any Baltimore ArcGIS layer by service path + layer id. Full ArcGIS query: where, out_fields, order_by, limit. Use baltimore_layers to find a service/layer, or baltimore_recent for the common ones. Epoch dates are converted to ISO.

layer.description: Layer id within the service (from baltimore_layers), e.g. 39.

service.description: ArcGIS service path, e.g. "311_Customer_Service_Requests_current/FeatureServer" (or a short name: crime|service_requests|permits).

name: baltimore_query
